threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still look puzzled when the bus driver shouts, 'Next stop, are you getting off or what?' after every stop.
Caught the 59 last night; a guy in a pineapple costume was arguing with the driver about the route. Only in Brixton, right?

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: That moment you hear the unmistakable sound of a late-night Kebab stand arguing over who has the best sauce – welcome to Neukölln.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Kreuzberg will you find a currywurst stand that doubles as an art gallery after dark. It's a perfect mix of sausage and creativity!

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: Only a true local knows to avoid BART on Fridays when there's a heatwave — overheated brakes lead to chaos in the Tube. Everyone else just grumbles.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a guy on the 38 Geary serenading passengers with an accordion. Half the bus clapped along, the other half just pretended to sleep.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think they can just stroll into a plaça for a quiet chat, but local kids turn them into an impromptu soccer pitch. Welcome to Gràcia.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: They still take photos of the local street art like it’s a hidden gem, not realizing it’s just Instagram bait for every tourist.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You can spot the newcomers by their confusion over whether to queue for the bus or just wave it down like it’s a taxi. Proper bus etiquette takes time.
Caught a night bus from Brixton last week; the driver was blasting old reggae. Half the bus was singing along, felt like a block party on wheels.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: When I heard a toddler arguing passionately with their parent about whether the garbage truck was a 'big truck' or a 'huge truck'—that's Neukölln.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: You can spot spontaneous dance parties in the subway stations here. Just last week, a group broke out into a conga line at Kottbusser Tor.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You notice the locals look up when the BART screeches—it's a weird instinct. Those just visiting jump at the noise like it's the first time.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a guy in a full tuxedo get on the 14. He looked like he had just come from a wedding, but spent the whole ride checking his phone like he was in a board meeting.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think Gràcia’s plazas are just for tapas and photos, but locals know they’re real community hubs come dusk, filled with laughter and life.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell a recent arrival by the way they still look at the metro map like it’s a treasure map—lost in the maze of lines and colors.
